title: "View all" → New from a record trail on ObjectDataPage still writes only the parent pair, not the dependsOn seed
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpEsWWE9Y5YtSsDgqZ

Found by the seat L1 on PR #37283 (#37246), 7162744164, S2(b). Same family as #37246.

## 维护者速读

- **问题：** 在相关页签点「新建」，现在会把依赖字段一起预填（#37246）。但从相关列表点「查看全部」进入列表页，再点「新建」，仍然只带父记录一项。依赖它的关联字段因此卡在「请先选择上级」，用户只能自己补选。
- **改法：** 「查看全部」路径的「新建」复用 #37246 的同一套预填（`relatedCreateSeedOf`）。

## What

`ObjectDataPage`'s New from a record trail ("View all") writes the parent pair alone. It does not apply the `dependsOn` seed that #37283 adds to the related-tab New.

## Done when

- That path seeds through the same `relatedCreateSeedOf`.
- One pin covers it, red without the fix.

## Notes

- Size S.
- **Blocked-by:** #37246 (PR #37283).
